decisions.subject: Exterior column spacing
decisions.approach: Perimeter axes use cited published bay and corner contraction spacings; individual inclinations and surveyed tolerances remain unmeasured.
decisions.basis: Published architectural aggregate spacing from Perseus Digital Library / published specialist work.

decisions.subject: Stylobate curvature and column entasis
decisions.approach: Only stylized entasis introduced; exact rise/inward lean not claimed
decisions.basis: YSMA describes refinements but data insufficient to derive measured per-column geometry

decisions.subject: Original roof
decisions.approach: Simple double-pitch architectural envelope and marble-like cladding
decisions.implication: No timber joinery or complete roofing details claimed

decisions.subject: Cult statue, frieze figures, reliefs and pedimental sculpture
decisions.approach: Omit original figural imagery; preserve structural placement and architectural description
decisions.basis: Loss, uncertainty and third-party reproduction rights
decisions.implication: No invented or unlicensed sculptural replicas

decisions.subject: Eastern U-shaped two-storey and western Ionic systems
decisions.approach: Represent nine lower shafts on each eastern long U-arm, three on the return, and two terminal piers, plus a simplified two-tier upper model; original exact member positions remain speculative.
decisions.basis: Museum describes two-tier U-shaped internal Doric support; Tufts/Perseus records nine long-side columns and a pier per side, plus three across the short return.

decisions.subject: Historical weather, lighting and terrain
decisions.approach: Generic directional sunlight, simple procedural ground, and an optional noticeable warm fog/dust simulation; all expressly nonhistorical.
decisions.basis: Visitor comfort rather than reconstructed fifth-century weather

revisitWhen: Site survey or rights-cleared measured drawings obtained
